Build passes with 0 errors now (exit code 0).

**What was actually broken (2 bugs from the bump, not noise):**
1. `src/core/options.js:6` — bundler now sends `{ retryCount }`, code still read `options.retries` → crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, but the check only handled `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Fixed to treat non-`true` as disabled.

The remaining ~8 warnings (DEP0142, DEP0198, deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, unused export, circular import) are pre-existing noise, not from your bump — build finishes clean, 0 errors.

Next: run your real test suite to confirm retry/backoff behavior is correct downstream.
